description: Get space back from the photos, videos and music already on your PC: smaller formats, every result checked, every change undoable.
notes: Settings and History are kept in your user profile, so updating or reinstalling keeps them.
The File Explorer right-click menu can be turned on in Wick's Settings.
Before uninstalling, turn off the right-click menu and 'Start at sign-in' in Settings if you turned them on.
